the attacker is an external party who does not own the asset, and no user interaction is needed (finbot-ctf-demo/src/main.py:18, finbot-ctf-demo/src/main.py:105, finbot-ctf-demo/gunicorn.conf.py:4, finbot-ctf-demo/README.md:5-9). Integrity of the vulnerable system is high because the agent's objectives and the approve_invoice write are fully controlled, while subsequent-system integrity is high because high-value invoices are approved for payment without review."},"evidence":{"LC":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/admin.py:90-109","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:735-748","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:69-71"],"CP":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/models/vendor.py:105","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:735-748","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:163-166"],"AP":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:347-361","finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/admin.py:26-65"],"RH":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:347-361","finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/admin.py:26-65"],"ES":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:228-345","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:347-361"],"CVSS":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/main.py:18","finbot-ctf-demo/src/main.py:105","finbot-ctf-demo/gunicorn.conf.py:4","finbot-ctf-demo/README.md:5-9","finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/admin.py:90-109"]},"confidence":{"LC":"high","CP":"high","AP":"medium","RH":"medium","ES":"high","CVSS":"high"},"rh_facts":{"reachable_proxy":true,"isolation_verified":false,"verified_episodes":0,"episodes_reviewed":0,"locus":"evaluator"},"automatable":"Yes","automatable_rationale":"The whole path is a single unauthenticated HTTP POST with a JSON body, followed by an ordinary invoice submission; no human step, secret, or target-specific condition is required, so it can be scripted end to end.","technical_impact":"Total","technical_impact_rationale":"The injected goals replace the agent's objectives for every later invoice from every vendor and drive approve_invoice, which sets status approved and payment_processed true with no amount check or confirmation, so the integrity of the approval decision and the payment record is fully lost.","applicability_as_implemented":{"model_directed_goal_pursuit":true,"selects_or_sequences_actions":true,"confidence":"high","rationale":"As deployed, the OpenAI client with gpt-4.1-mini drives a tool_choice auto loop of up to 5 iterations and the model itself selects approve_invoice, reject_invoice, or request_human_review, so the model both pursues the injected goals and sequences the tool actions."},"applicability_as_modeled":{"model_directed_goal_pursuit":true,"selects_or_sequences_actions":true,"confidence":"high","rationale":"The documentation describes FinBot as an autonomous invoice processing assistant whose goals are built per request from FinBotConfig and whose custom goals override conflicting instructions, so the documented agent pursues model-directed goals and chooses the tool sequence."},"refusal":null}
